prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve and style-transfer.
Asset: one transparent player avatar in the established cozy Ukrainian board-game painted cat portrait series.
Input images: Image 1 is the ONLY human identity, face, expression, haircut, pose and clothing reference, Vitalik Yuskiv. Image 2 supplies ONLY the approved warm gouache/colored-pencil medium, actual feline anatomy, contained bust framing and finish. Do not copy image 2's face, eye shape, dark chin mark or patterned polo. This is a different person.
Primary request: reimagine the man in image 1 as a recognizable anthropomorphic CAT. Preserve his long fairly broad oval/rectangular face, high forehead, straight dark eyebrows, naturally very NARROW smiling/sun-squinting eyes at their original spacing, gently raised cheeks, small relaxed closed-mouth smile, defined broad rounded chin and long neck. The narrow eyes are distinctive: do not make them large, wide-open, doll-like or surprised. Preserve the friendly calm slight smile from the source. Clean-shaven appearance, no beard, moustache or invented chin spot. Natural young-adult facial proportions rather than an older bearded or muscular cartoon character. Real short natural feline muzzle, small cat nose and fine whiskers; muted warm sandy/taupe fur with cream cheek and muzzle highlights.
Hair: very short dark brown/near-black close-cropped hair, neat short top with a simple straight hairline, closely faded sides, no quiff, long fringe or swept-back spikes.
Anatomy: EXACTLY TWO pointed CAT ears TOTAL, on TOP of the head, both fully contained with generous clear margin above. Eye-level sides of head must be uninterrupted short fur/hair: NO human ears, side ears, extra lower ears or fleshy lobes.
Clothing: fully clothed dark burgundy/maroon long-sleeved crewneck sweatshirt with visible subtle raglan shoulder seams, soft cotton texture and relaxed broad shoulders, matching the photo. Omit all printed words, lettering, logos and black chest graphic. No polo collar, jacket or hoodie.
Style: detailed warm hand-painted gouache and colored pencil, softly dimensional textured fur, cropped hair and sweatshirt cotton, warm brown outlines and ivory highlights, matching established character portraits.
Composition: square canvas, single centered fully frontal head-and-upper-torso bust, level shoulders and source's friendly squinting expression, naturally rounded lower shoulder silhouette, full head, ears and upper torso contained with ample transparent margins. No hands or lower body.
Backdrop: genuine transparent alpha. Remove the wall, giant lettering, signs and all background scenery. No other people, props, circle, badge, frame, text or watermark.
